findings.title: Telemetry delivery can accumulate unbounded pending MainActor tasks
findings.status: Source-proven queueing behavior; live growth magnitude requires macOS profiling
findings.basis: The recurring telemetry delivery path creates a fresh unstructured MainActor task that captures the update payload. No pending-task/latest-value gate is visible in the surrounding source. When production outruns MainActor consumption, queued tasks and their captured snapshots accumulate until serviced.
findings.validation: Instrument produced, scheduled, applied, dropped/coalesced, and maximum pending depth; stall MainActor for three seconds while telemetry continues.
